svg.title: Chaos Mesh microkernel architecture
svg.desc: Microkernel architecture for chaos-controller-manager: stable core of controller-runtime manager, reconciliation pipeline, selector engine, and CRD webhook framework; 14+ chaos fault plug-ins registered via ChaosImpl interface (Apply + Recover) through fx.Annotated dependency injection.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does chaos-controller-manager receive chaos experiment requests?')
g.text: Kubernetes API server — user applies ChaosObject

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the controller-runtime manager do in Chaos Mesh?')

sendPrompt('What does the selector engine do in Chaos Mesh?')
sendPrompt('What is the ChaosImpl interface — Apply() and Recover()?')
g.text: Apply() · Recover() — only interface any plug-in must implement

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does fx.Annotated Group impl register chaos plugins?')
g.text: fx.Annotated{Group: "impl"} dependency injection — controllers/chaosimpl/fx.go — wires plug-ins at startup
